title: Turkish-Style Lamb Kofte
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring flavorful lamb kofte, inspired by the flavors of the Mediterranean.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground lamb, finely chopped onion, breadcrumbs, crumbled feta cheese, chopped parsley, salt, black pepper, and Turkish red pepper flakes.
3. Use your hands to mix the ingredients until just combined.
4. Cover the mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
5. Divide the mixture into 8 equal portions and shape each portion into a kofte.
6. Thread the kofte onto skewers, leaving a small space between each kofte.
7. Grill the kofte for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
8. Serve the kofte hot with your favorite sides, such as rice pilaf, salad, or grilled vegetables.
